verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a low-code Flow getting-started path, a Hosted Payment Page marketed as live 'in less than a day', an official Node.js SDK, and a public test account with test cards, so a quick payment integration is plausible from first-party materials. Nothing in the evidence shows copy-paste code samples across languages or independent confirmation of the under-a-day timeline. Missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste code examples in multiple languages, SDKs beyond Node.js and mobile, and hands-on corroboration of the under-a-day integration claim.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language

citations.quote: Get a fully branded checkout page in less than a day.
The official Node.js SDK for Checkout.com payment gateway.
A dedicated test-account environment with per-scenario testing docs
